T: Thawed out caveman. Ready to eat.
D: Two high school losers dig up a frozen caveman in their backyard and pass him off as an exchange student.
P: Serve the snacks when Link is thawed out in the garage.
S: Link's ice block cheddar cheese ball
Cheddar and cream cheese ball with jalapeño, rolled in bacon and pretzel crumbs

Sharp cheddar and cream cheese beaten with pickled jalapeño and smoked paprika, rolled in crushed pretzels and bacon, served on ice with crackers. Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeño, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 2 hours. Fry 4 rashers bacon until crisp and crumble with 60g crushed pretzels and chopped chives. Roll the ball in the crumb and serve on a plate of crushed ice with crackers.
Smoky paprika drumsticks roasted until sticky with barbecue sauce
Chicken drumsticks rubbed with smoked paprika, garlic and brown sugar, roasted at 220C for 40 minutes until sticky, eaten with your hands like a caveman.
the backyard where they dig the pool

Corn chips baked under black beans, chorizo and two cheeses, piled with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeño and a squeeze of lime. Fry 1 diced chorizo until crisp. Layer 300g corn chips on a tray with the chorizo, 1 drained tin black beans, 150g grated cheddar and 100g grated mozzarella, and bake at 200C for 8 minutes. Mash 2 avocados with lime and salt. Top the nachos with guacamole, sour cream, pickled jalapeños, coriander and lime wedges.
M: Teriyaki chicken thigh skewers, grilled and basted, with steamed rice
Chicken thigh skewers marinated in teriyaki, ginger and garlic, grilled and served with rice and sesame.
Meat group! A big hunk of beef on the bone, eaten with both hands

Beef short ribs rubbed with paprika and brown sugar, slow-roasted until they pull from the bone, glazed with barbecue sauce, with a crunchy slaw. Heat the oven to 160°C. Rub the ribs with the sugar, paprika, garlic powder and salt. Put the ribs in a deep tray with the stock, cover tightly with foil and roast until tender. Brush with barbecue sauce and roast uncovered until sticky. Toss the cabbage and carrot with the mayonnaise and vinegar and serve with the ribs.
W: Honey vanilla yoghurt frozen with berries and pistachios, broken into shards
Greek yoghurt mixed with honey and vanilla, spread thin on a tray, scattered with berries and crushed nuts, frozen 4 hours, broken into shards.
K: Strawberry layered under a thick mango, banana, pineapple and orange smoothie

Mango, banana, pineapple and orange juice blended thick and frosty, with a swirl of strawberry purée up the glass like a California sunset. Blend 200g frozen strawberries with 1 tbsp honey and spoon into the bottom of 4 tall glasses. Blend 2 chopped mangoes, 2 frozen bananas, 200g pineapple, 400ml orange juice and a handful of ice until thick. Pour slowly over the strawberry so it swirls up the sides and serve with a straw.

s.note: Cheddar and cream cheese ball with jalapeño, rolled in bacon and pretzel crumbs
s.how: Beat 250g soft cream cheese with 200g grated sharp cheddar, 2 tbsp chopped pickled jalapeño, 1 tsp smoked paprika and 1 tsp Worcestershire. Shape into a ball, wrap and chill 2 hours. s.note: Smoky paprika drumsticks roasted until sticky with barbecue sauce
s.how: Rub 1kg chicken drumsticks with 2 tsp smoked paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder and 2 tbsp brown sugar. Roast at 220C for 40 minutes, brushing with barbecue sauce for the last 10, until sticky.

m.note: Teriyaki chicken thigh skewers, grilled and basted, with steamed rice
m.how: Toss 1kg diced chicken thigh in 125ml teriyaki sauce with 1 tbsp grated ginger and 2 crushed garlic cloves and marinate for 30 minutes. Thread onto 12 skewers and grill for 10 to 12 minutes, turning and basting. Serve with steamed rice and sesame seeds.

w.note: Honey vanilla yoghurt frozen with berries and pistachios, broken into shards
w.how: Mix 500g Greek yoghurt with 3 tbsp honey and vanilla. Spread thin on a lined tray, scatter with 150g mixed berries and 40g crushed pistachios. Freeze 4 hours and break into shards.

d.note: Strawberry layered under a thick mango, banana, pineapple and orange smoothie
d.how: Blend 200g frozen strawberries with 1 tbsp honey and spoon into the bottom of 4 tall glasses. Blend 2 chopped mangoes, 2 frozen bananas, 200g pineapple, 400ml orange juice and a handful of ice until thick. Pour slowly over the strawberry so it swirls up the sides and serve with a straw.
